name: KEDE Numerical Control Co., Ltd.
summary: KEDE Numerical Control Co., Ltd. is a Chinese enterprise that specializes in the production and distribution of advanced Computer Numerical Control (CNC) systems alongside essential functional components. The company's product line encompasses a diverse array of machining centers, featuring sophisticated models like five-axis vertical, horizontal, and turning machines. Their offerings also include horizontal milling and turning compound units, specialized tool grinding equipment, high-speed bridge-type gantry systems, and blade milling machining centers. This extensive selection is further enhanced by their unique Detron series. In addition to complete systems, KEDE supplies vital functional parts such as precision motors, electric spindles, integrated sensing systems, direct drive milling heads, and robust turntables. Established in 2008 and headquartered in Dalian, China, KEDE Numerical Control Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Dalian Koyo Technology Group Co., Ltd.
